params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: bug  Priority: P2
Summary: A source whose page has moved loses the address it was pasted with on its way through the Studio, so the repair of Trendwolves/gentells-pipeline#486 cannot be reached from the screen; and when one source is not taken, the message does not say why.

Source: Portal mail:61, the repair of source 16 of Growing Up in Public tried from the Studio.

## What happens

- "Check against Gentells" reads the page and hands back the address the page answers from. The Studio sends that address on when adding; the pasted one, which the report prints, is gone.
- Pasting the address of a source that is in the list under its new address answers "0 sources added, one was not taken", with no reason.

## Expected

- The pasted address travels with the line from the check to the add (pipeline side: Trendwolves/gentells-pipeline#489).
- When exactly one source is not taken, the message gives the reason.
params.title: Report source list: the pasted address of a moved page is lost between check and add
